ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The motion has two perpendicular parts: first 6 m due north from O to A, then 8 m due west from A to B, with total time 5 s. The length of the path is the actual distance traveled, so it is 6 + 8 = 14 m. The displacement is the straight-line distance from the starting point O to the final point B. The magnitude of average velocity is displacement divided by total time, so 10 m / 5 s = 2 m/s.
